minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income: Minimum income of S$30,000p.a. OR S$15,000p.a. (for age 55 & above)

our_takes.our-take: The DCS Ultimate Platinum Card offers a flat 2% cashback on the first S$10,000 monthly spend – a decent option if you want simplicity without juggling bonus categories. The S$200 monthly cap is key; high spenders might find it limiting. The numberless card design boosts security, a plus in today's environment. While the first-year fee is waived, the subsequent S$196.20 annual fee makes it worthwhile only if you consistently max out the cashback. Consider alternatives if your spending is heavily concentrated in specific categories like dining or groceries, as other cards may offer higher targeted rewards.
our_takes.good-for:
Salaried professionals seeking cashback on daily expenses such as transportation, groceries, and dining out.
Individuals who value security features such as numberless cards to protect against personal data theft.
Singaporeans or PRs above 55, with income above S$15,000, seeking a card with complimentary insurance coverage.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A S$196.20 annual fee applies after the first year; consider if the card's benefits justify this cost.
Late payment fees of S$100 apply if minimum repayment isn't met, so pay promptly to avoid this charge.
A high 26.90% interest rate accrues on unpaid balances, so aim to pay in full monthly.
